$comment: Illustrative MCP server manifest for thehosksaid.com. Adapt to the discovery format your runtime expects; the canonical contract is the live MCP handshake at the endpoint below.
name: thehosksaid
description: Retrieval over an independent, AI-generated transcript index of Charles Hoskinson's public videos (talks, AMAs, whiteboards). Use search_segments or search_keyword to get bounded, timestamped source passages with citations and answer with your own model; search_archive optionally returns an answer written by this site's model.

authentication.note: Anonymous access is rate-limited (60 req/min/IP, each JSON-RPC message counts; at most 8 messages per POST). Send 'Authorization: Bearer <key>' with a maintainer-issued HoskSaid access key for 600 req/min; unrecognized or empty bearer keys return 401. This server never asks for, accepts or stores a model-provider key (OpenAI, Anthropic, OpenRouter or local): your MCP client keeps its own model credentials and runs its own model on the passages these tools return. Tools never modify the archive. search_segments spends one site-funded query embedding under per-client and site daily caps; search_keyword spends no model call at all; search_archive spends a site-funded answer under daily caps and stores the question and answer.

tools.name: search_archive
tools.description: Answer written by THIS SITE'S model (site-funded, daily-capped per client and site-wide, question and answer stored), citation-backed from timestamped transcript segments. To answer with your own model instead, call search_segments or search_keyword and give the passages to your model.

tools.name: search_segments
tools.description: Retrieval only, no answer generated: semantic search returning up to 50 ranked transcript passages with video title, date, timestamp, deep link and a ready-made citation string, for your own model to read and cite. Each uncached query spends one site-funded embedding under per-client and site daily caps (your model credentials do not raise them); when they run out, use search_keyword.

tools.name: search_keyword
tools.description: Retrieval only, no model call and no embedding: keyword matches in titles, tags and full transcripts with an excerpt, date and deep link. Also reaches videos that have no semantic segments. Follow up with get_transcript or get_segment for full passages.

query.description: Postgres websearch syntax: words, "quoted phrases", OR, -exclude.

tools.name: get_video
tools.description: Full metadata, chapters and topics for a single indexed video.

tools.name: get_transcript
tools.description: The complete transcript of a video as segments, plain text, or WebVTT.

tools.name: get_segment
tools.description: A single timestamped segment with its neighbours and a deep link to the moment.

tools.name: list_videos
tools.description: Paginated catalogue of all indexed videos.

tools.name: list_topics
tools.description: Every clustered topic with citation, video and segment counts.
